item.title: Version 0.0.2
item.description:
# LincolnLab-388 0.0.2
This is the first version that updates itself. From now on the app checks for a new version at launch and once a day, and LincolnLab-388 ▸ Check for Updates… checks right away. Nothing is installed until you click Install Update.
## Sound and tape
- **Tape motion:** the tape now speeds up and slows down like a real deck. PLAY glides up to pitch, STOP glides down as the tape coasts, and winds speed up and brake. A recording started from a stop begins only once the tape is up to speed. - **PITCH CONT works:** on VARI the knob changes the tape speed by ±15 %, so pitch and tempo change with it. FIX locks the speed. - **Tape hiss:** tracks with dbx off now have a little tape hiss while the tape rolls, as on the real unit. Turn it off with Audio ▸ Tape Hiss. - **Transport sounds:** the keys clunk, REC clicks its relay, and a wind with the TAPE LIFTER released has its hum. You hear these in the monitor only. They are never recorded.
## Mixer
- **AUX works:** the AUX sends, PRE/POST and MASTER AUX are live. Audio ▸ AUX Out sends the AUX buss to a spare output on your interface, for a cue mix or an outboard effect. - MONITOR/PHONES and METER now read the AUX and EFF positions.
## Recording and reels
- **File ▸ Import Audio…** puts an audio file onto a track, starting at the tape position. It has a gain field, and a stereo file takes two tracks. - REC FUNCTION and REPEAT are saved with the reel and come back as you left them. - The TAPE LIFTER now looks like the one on the unit and stays where you left it across launches. - A reel open in one copy of the app can no longer be opened in a second copy. - RTZ and STC now land on their spot even when you press them while the tape is already winding close to it.
## Web Remote
- **Remote ▸ Web Remote** lets a phone or iPad on the same network work the deck. Scan the QR code or open the link. - The TRANSPORT page has the counter, the memory and transport keys, the TAPE LIFTER and the MONITOR/PHONES LEVEL knob. - The MIXER page (made for an iPad on its side) has the channel strips, the master and monitor sections, REC FUNCTION, dbx and PITCH CONT, with live meters. - Anyone with the link can work the transport and the mixer, so share it only with people you trust.
